notes.title: Memoranda Update v1.1
notes.content:
A new update (v1.1) is now available for [b]Memoranda[/b]. There have been some improvements to better lead the player along the game, including some new dialog and memos. There's also a lot of small improvements throughout the game to hopefully provide a better experience. As always, please let us know if you find any bugs or issues if you encounter any.

Next up on our list is to add localizations to the game. It will take some time to translate, quality check and do the editing required to incorporate them, so stay tuned for it.

If you have any questions or want to report a bug, you can reach us at memoranda@digitaldragongames.com

Thanks to all of our players and have fun!
